resumeText:
Vikram Reddy | Hyderabad | vikram.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Deccan Pay Technologies, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Built Java Spring Boot microservices for UPI collect and intent payments handling 2 million transactions a day.
- Integrated the UPI switch with partner bank APIs over REST, using idempotency keys and retry handling.
- Wrote the daily reconciliation job that matches NPCI settlement files against the internal ledger.
- Published payment status events to Kafka for notifications and refunds.
- Designed MySQL schemas and indexes for the transaction store.
- Removed card numbers from logs and moved to tokenised references during a PCI DSS audit.

SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, MySQL, UPI, HLD

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, JNTU Hyderabad, 2021
